info.name: AlphaSense Agent Authentication Workflow Agents API

items.docs: Single GraphQL endpoint that fronts the AlphaSense Agent API and Utility APIs. Submit a query or mutation in the body; the operation selects the surface (GenSearch, Deep Research, Workflow Agents, Document Search, Companies, Brokers, Watchlist, Trends, User, Download). Authentication is the bearer token from /auth plus the x-api-key header.
